title: Linear-Time Pair Equality Decision
statement: For all binary words $u$ and $v$, the pair comparator, started on the encoding that doubles each bit of $u$, appends the separator $01$, and then appends $v$, halts within $3|u|+|v|+4$ steps and outputs the one-bit word whose bit is true exactly when $u=v$.
replaced: For all binary strings $u$ and $v$, the pair comparator, on the self-delimiting encoding of the pair $(u,v)$, halts within $3|u| + |v| + 4$ steps with output the single bit recording whether $u = v$.
